import argparse
import sys
from collections import Counter

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Count whitespace-separated integers")
    parser.add_argument("numbers", nargs="+", type=int, help="Numbers to count")
    parser.add_argument("--min", type=int, help="Minimum value to include")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.min is not None:
        args.numbers = [num for num in args.numbers if num >= args.min]

    counts = Counter(args.numbers)
    for num, count in counts.items():
        print(f"{num} {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
results.instruction: Build a stdin histogram CLI. Count whitespace-separated integers and print each value and count separated by one space in numeric order. Add --min to drop values below the supplied integer.

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Persistent command-line bookmark manager")
    parser.add_argument("json_file", help="JSON data file")
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["add", "list", "remove"], help="Command to execute")
    parser.add_argument("name", nargs="?", help="Name of the bookmark")
    parser.add_argument("url", nargs="?", help="URL of the bookmark")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not os.path.exists(args.json_file):
        print("Error: JSON file not found")
        sys.exit(1)

    with open(args.json_file, "r") as file:
        bookmarks = json.load(file)

    if args.command == "add":
        if not args.name or not args.url:
            print("Error: Name and URL are required")
            sys.exit(1)
        bookmarks[args.name] = args.url
    elif args.command == "list":
        for name, url in sorted(bookmarks.items()):
            print(f"{name}\t{url}")
    elif args.command == "remove":
        if not args.name:
            print("Error: Name is required")
            sys.exit(1)
        if args.name not in bookmarks:
            print("Error: Bookmark not found")
            sys.exit(1)
        del bookmarks[args.name]
    else:
        print("Error: Invalid command")
        sys.exit(1)

    with open(args.json_file, "w") as file:
        json.dump(bookmarks, file, indent=4)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
